verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Xero's user/role invitation feature for accountants or bookkeepers (e.g., 'Invite a user', advisor vs standard roles); the only accountant-related mention (xero-docs-4) refers to the App Store's audience for third-party app developers, not to inviting one's own accountant into the org. Missing for 10: any documentation of user invitation flow, role/permission levels (advisor, standard, read-only), or accountant-specific access controls.
